# Paid media audit checklist

Score pass / fail / unknown / n/a with evidence. Unknown is never fail. Skip rows that do not apply to the client's business model.

## Gates
- conversion-tracking-audit gate pass or pass_with_gaps, under 90 days
- Offline/server-side outcomes working per platform with automated bidding; last upload date and match rate known
- Value model by segment on file (profile)

## Structure
- Campaigns split by segment and brand vs non-brand
- Landing page per segment, matched to the ad group
- Naming convention followed

## Targeting
- Location option = presence, all platforms
- Geo matches the profile (service area, ship-to regions, sales markets); outside areas excluded (where allowed; not in special-category campaigns)
- Ad schedule matches answered hours when calls matter
- Special Ad Category / restricted targeting set correctly on financing-led and technician-hiring campaigns

## Queries and negatives
- Search-terms report reviewed on cadence
- Standing negative themes present
- PMax brand exclusions on

## Conversions
- One primary conversion per real outcome (no double counting)
- Primary conversion maps to the profile's qualified outcome
- Conversion values by segment

## Feeds (e-com)
- Merchant Center diagnostics clean or triaged; price/availability match; policy status for restricted products

## Budget and pacing
- Pacing vs month-to-date qualified outcomes
- Capacity check done before any increase
- Demand plan on file (`demand-seasonality-planner`)

## Compliance
- Live ad copy passes `claims-check` with the client's vertical pack
